analysis.name: Chipotle Burrito Bowl (brown rice, black beans, double chicken, guac)

items.name: Chipotle burrito bowl with brown rice, black beans, double chicken, fajita veggies, corn salsa, cheese and guacamole (no sour cream)

analysis.notes: Logged as one dish since a burrito bowl is a single composed meal. Estimates use Chipotle's published serving data: 4 oz brown rice, black beans, 2x chicken (~8 oz cooked), fajita veggies, corn salsa, shredded cheese, and roughly a half scoop of guacamole. Sodium is high (~1680 mg) which is generally fine given the morning training session, but worth noting. Carbs ~86 g may be on the low side for post-long-session refueling — consider adding tortilla chips or a beverage with carbs if recovery glycogen is a priority.
